QUOTE: Calling `mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init(buf, len)` installs it by calling `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free()` internally (`memory_buffer_alloc.c:566-576`).
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the buffer allocator installs itself via the setter from its init function, but never says it is the only in-tree user of the setter, which the item requires.
